name: cavemio-toggle-group
title: Toggle group
description: On/off choices side by side whose fills merge: two pressed toggles next to each other square off their inner corners and read as one shape.

cavemio.accessibility:
- For one choice, use the segmented control.
- Reduced motion: fills and corners change at once.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

features.title: Merging fills
